title: _summary.json - what the run did, and whether it can be believed
description: Written by src/analyse/summarise_run.py when a run completes, beside the human-readable SUMMARY.md. It answers three questions a completed run should never leave hanging: what was run, did it relax, and did its own accounting close. It is DELIBERATELY NOT a model result: it carries no mode share, no patronage, no fit statistic and no comparison against a validation target. Those come from extract_metrics.py -> fit.py -> report.py, which are the only route to a reportable number (DECISIONS.md 12.1). Everything here is about the RUN's state, not about Newcastle.

generated_utc.description: when this summary was written. Provenance only - it is not model data, and the run itself is seeded and deterministic.

run.description: identity and cost, copied from _run.json and the resolved config. A picture or a number can never be separated from the run that produced it.

controler_sha256.description: the entry point that produced this run. A summary produced before a controler change and one produced after must not be confusable.

relaxation.description: Whether the run settled. After MATSim disables innovation no new plans are created, so any remaining movement in mode share is relaxation, not search - which is exactly the question issue #5 turns on. This is a statement about the RUN, not about mode choice in Newcastle.

drift_pp.description: percentage-point change per mode between the innovation cutoff and the final iteration

tolerance_pp.description: largest movement a mode may still show and be reported as settled, in percentage points. Declared as RUN.relaxation.drift_tolerance_pp and swept, never asserted: it decides the verdict, so it is reported beside it and a reader may apply their own.

from_iteration.description: first iteration of the window the movement was measured over - the first iteration at or after the innovation cutoff. Null when the run did not reach it.

to_iteration.description: last iteration of that window. A settled verdict means nothing without the two iteration numbers it was settled between.

relaxed.description: false when any mode is still moving by more than tolerance_pp between from_iteration and to_iteration. Null when the run did not reach the cutoff.

integrity.description: Whether the run's own accounting closed. A run whose departures do not equal arrivals + stuck + unresolved has lost agents, and no number taken from it means anything.

activity.description: Legs the final iteration generated, by mode and by transit vehicle type. Counts of what the mobsim moved - NOT a mode share, and not comparable to a validation target.

not_a_result.description: Stated in the document itself, so the file cannot be quoted out of context.

next.description: the declared pipeline to reach a reportable number from here
